utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Leo, the repair drive’s this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ve been telling everyone so more neighbors can make it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik, but Rosa moved it to Sunday at the community center, with the shed roof first—please update folks, and we still need two more people for the heavier boards.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell folks it’s Sunday at the community center, starting with the shed roof, and that we still need two more people for the heavier boards.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Noah—the repair drive’s still on Saturday in the parking lot from 10 to 2, and I meant to bring my toolbox but I can still pitch in however I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday, right—thanks, I’d lost track again. If you hear whether we’re still short on shingles, drills, or gloves, let me know so I can keep up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Noah—I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear we’re still short on shingles, drills, or gloves.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the community center lot, but can someone lock down the exact Saturday time and whether we’ve already got enough screws and extension cords?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: As far as I know, it’s still 9 on Saturday, and we’re starting with the leaking shed roof first. Jules said we’re still collecting tools and spare parts, so I don’t think we’ve got enough screws and extension cords locked in yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, community center lot at 9 then, and the leaking shed roof comes first. Can you have someone confirm the time for sure and check who’s bringing screws and extension cords?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we move anything forward, can you confirm the exact date and location, and give me a checked list of the tools and supplies we already have versus what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still pinning down the final date and location with Mara, but it’s for this weekend, and I’m checking the full list now so I can send you a clean rundown of what we already have versus what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—please send me the exact date and location once Mara confirms, and include a verified split between what’s already on hand and what still needs sourcing before I assign anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces, Rey, but I heard Friday after school pickup is when folks can bring tools or spare parts by—do you know if that’s when the repair drive actually starts too?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard the repair drive itself is Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center parking lot. Friday after pickup sounds more like a drop-off time for tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps a lot—so Friday’s just for dropping things off, and the repair drive itself is Saturday from 10 to 2. Do you know if they’re still especially needing screws and extension cords?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again, Opal—I'm still happy to help spread the word, but can we confirm the date, time, and whether it’s definitely at the community center first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—it’s at the community center lot, with the drop-off table by the east entrance; I’ve got that marked. I’m still waiting on the date and time, so once those are confirmed I’ll pass them straight to you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks—once the date and time are locked in, send them my way and I’ll start spreading the word right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves for the repair drive—if you can bring any of that, I’ll put your name on my list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Put me down for extra gloves, Cleo, and let’s keep the rest simple with one clear list and a 9 o’clock start at the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, Eli—I’ve marked you down for extra gloves, and I’ll keep the list clear with the 9 o’clock start at the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara—I've got the drill, spare screwdrivers, and sawhorses ready, so just send me the time once you’ve got the Maple list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—that helps a ton. It’s Saturday, and I’ve got you down for the ladder, drills, tape measure, screwdrivers, topped-off batteries, plus extension cords if Cleo still needs them; I’ll send the time as soon as the Maple list’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect—I'll have all that packed and ready for Saturday, and once you send the time I can plan to stay a few hours if needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by briefly and start with a quick supply check, then leave you a short list before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Uli—thank you. Start with the basic tools and supplies, and just leave me the short list before you go so I can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright—I’ll check the basic tools first and leave you a short list before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, what time can you get to the repair drive, and how long can I count on you to stay?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can make time once they stop moving the details around, but I really need the final start time and parking plan first so I’m not promising the wrong thing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fine—once I send the final start time and parking plan, what arrival window and stay length can you commit to?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’m hearing, it is confirmed for Friday after school pickup, and they’re especially hoping for spare screws and extension cords if you do decide to bring anything over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s actually bringing the tools and who’s handling the heavy stuff before I count on Friday after pickup?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t got the full list of who’s hauling the heavy stuff yet, Kira, but Friday after school pickup is the confirmed drop-off window. I’ll ask around and let you know who’s bringing tools before you make the trip.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Faye—I’m still out running errands, so just send me a quick update if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do—I’m still good for mid-morning through early afternoon, as long as I’m free for school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that helps a lot—mid-morning through early afternoon should work well. Just keep me posted if anything shifts while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s start with the shed roof first, Bo, and the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. After that, I’ll have you help me sort the smaller fixes on the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, shed roof first at the community center on Sunday—good. Do we already have the extension cords and spare screws covered, or should I chase those down?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Please chase those down, Bo—let’s make sure we have the extension cords and spare screws ready for Sunday at the community center, and then we’ll be in good shape to start on the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s on Saturday, and Gus has the ladder, drills, tape measure, screwdrivers, and charged batteries covered; Cleo’s still tracking gloves, tape, and spare screws, plus extension cords if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps a lot—Saturday at the community center parking lot, 10 to 2. Last I heard we still especially needed shingles and more gloves, so I’ll keep checking in one-on-one.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—that lines up with what I’ve got, and I’ll let Cleo know gloves are still a priority while you keep checking on shingles one-on-one.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to know—Gus can bring a ladder and a drill, so we’re mainly short one more ladder and extra gloves now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks—that helps. I’m still out, so keep me posted if the ladder or glove situation changes and I’ll pass the note along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do—I'm checking on one more ladder and extra gloves now, and I’ll update you as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Jules, let’s keep it straightforward: start at 9 at the community center lot, with the drop-off table by the east entrance and one clear repair list posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—that gives us a clear setup, and I’ll loop in Mara and the other groups so we can cover supplies, posting the repair list, and keeping the drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Jules—that keeps it tidy; let’s stick with 9 at the community center lot, get the list posted by the east entrance, and have setup ready a little before then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Faye, I’m glad you can help mid-morning, but can you confirm who’s actually bringing the tools and how we’re handling the heavy stuff before I count on this drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Cleo’s tracking supplies, and last I heard we still need two working drills, shingles, and gloves, so I can’t promise the tool side yet. For the heavy stuff, I can help after morning drop-off, but we should lock in a couple of stronger folks with a truck before you count on me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, that’s still a maybe to me—can you confirm which two folks with a truck are actually in, or are we still just hoping someone steps up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Pia, I’m still telling folks the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and once the heavy hauling’s covered I know you’re good to help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s close, but I still need the final day, one clear start time, the parking setup, and who’s doing the heavy hauling before I repeat it and we jam up the morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, Pia — it’s Saturday, starting at 10 at the community center parking lot, and I’m telling folks that once the heavy hauling and parking setup are confirmed, you’ll be ready to help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re still set for 9 on Saturday at the leaking community shed roof, and I’m bringing the ladder and tarps. I’m waiting on the last details about parking and heavy hauling so I can give everyone a clear update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — 9 on Saturday at the shed roof, got it. If you hear the parking or hauling details, can you let me know again so I don’t get turned around?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll send you the parking and hauling details as soon as I get them, so you’ll know exactly where to go at 9.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, the repair drive’s still on Saturday in the parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’m planning to help even if I forgot my toolbox again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to know—I’m late as usual, but I can still spread the word; can you confirm it’s definitely Saturday, 10 to 2, in the parking lot before I start telling folks?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’m pretty sure that’s right—Saturday, parking lot, 10 to 2, unless Mina changed something and I missed it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Uli, I’m spreading the word fast—the repair drive still needs shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves, so come by if you can and pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by and get things started, but I can only stay a little while today. I’ll pass along that you still need shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That helps a ton, Uli—thanks for getting things started and spreading the word; even a short stop makes a difference.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, let’s count Maple and Cedar together right now—once we have that total, what hours are you actually free to help verify the open repair requests?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s total Maple and Cedar first, but I need the current open-request count for each street before I give you my verification hours.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fine—what’s the latest open-request count on Maple and on Cedar right now, so we can total them and lock your hours?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, Opal—do you know if they’re still collecting tools and supplies, and whether it’s starting Friday after school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the location details pinned down, but I’m still waiting on the date to be confirmed, so I can’t say Friday for sure yet. Bo also wanted us to check whether we already have enough spare screws and extension cords before asking for more supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it—I’d only heard Friday second-hand, so thanks for clearing that up. If you hear the date’s confirmed, will you let me know, and I can ask around about the screws and extension cords too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still good to bring the drill, spare screwdrivers, and some extension cords, and I’ll top off the batteries before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Gus—that covers one of the drills, and I’ll mark the screwdrivers and cords down too. We still need shingles and more gloves if you hear of anyone who can bring those.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it—I’ll ask around about shingles and extra gloves, and I’ll still show up with the drill, screwdrivers, cords, and fresh batteries.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m still holding off until it’s final—I need one public start time, the parking setup, and who’s handling hauling so we don’t send people to the wrong place or have them circling.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Exactly, and thank you for holding it steady—what’s firm right now is Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send you the single start time, parking setup, and hauling lead together once I lock them in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that’s what I needed—once you’ve got those three details together, I can help spread it without confusing anyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I move the repair drive forward, can you confirm the date, location, the current Maple-and-Cedar open request count, and exactly which tools and supplies we’ve verified on hand?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s Sunday at the community center, with the shed roof still first, and we’ve verified Gus is bringing a ladder and two drills; I’m still confirming the Maple-and-Cedar open request count and the rest of the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps. Before I assign anyone, can you confirm the Maple-and-Cedar count and whether screws, extension cords, gloves, and tape are actually verified on hand or still just expected?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That helps a lot, Rey—I’ll keep telling folks we still need shingles, one more working drill, and extra gloves, and that Gus has the drill and sawhorses covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll keep checking for that extra drill and more gloves, and I’m still asking around about shingles too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey—that’s a big help; I’ll keep spreading the word that we still need shingles, one more working drill, and extra gloves, and tell folks to come by the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Gus—let’s keep it straightforward: 9 at the community center lot, with the drop-off table by the east entrance and one clear parking note for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll be there at 9 by the east entrance with my drill, screwdrivers, tape measure, extension cord, and whatever spare screws I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Gus—that gives us a solid start. I’ll stick with 9 at the community center lot and keep the east entrance setup and parking note clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s what I’d heard too—sounds like they’re still collecting, and Friday after school pickup is the time to bring things by. Do you know what time the weekend organizing starts?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still pinning down the exact start time, but it is this weekend, and I can check with Mara and the other groups today so I can send you the confirmed time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules—that helps. If you hear back today, could you let me know the start time once it’s confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need shingles, two working drills, and more gloves; if you can bring zip ties or a couple of extension cords too, I’ll add those to the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, I’m a bit late to this, but I can help spread the word and try to bring extension cords or zip ties—what’s the confirmed date, time, and place so I can start asking around?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — it’s this Saturday at 9 a.m. in the Maple Street lot by the tool shed; if you can confirm the extension cords or zip ties, I’ll mark you down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s good to hear—I’m still trying to keep my time around school drop-off and pickup, but I can spread the word to families and check what supplies I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Faye—Friday after school pickup still sounds like the best window, and they could especially use spare screws and extension cords if you’re able to mention that to families.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Friday after pickup works best for me too, so I’ll mention the screws and extension cords to the other parents and plan to come by once the school run’s done.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can swing by and get the basics set up so it’s easier to follow, but I’ll need to head out again before too long.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, thanks, Uli — I’m still a little turned around on the repair drive, so that helps a lot. Just let me know what’s set up once I catch up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll start with the supply table and the sign-in sheet, then I’ll tell you what’s in place before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Opal, what time can you get to the repair drive, and how long can I count on you to stay?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can be at the community center lot by 8, and you can count on me through early afternoon so I can keep the route and drop-off setup straight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—plan on 8 to early afternoon, then. Can you also take point on the route and drop-off setup from the start?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I can help, but I should double-check the time since I’ve heard both the parking lot from 10 to 2 and the community shed by noon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s Saturday at 9 by the leaking shed roof, and we’re starting there unless Jules sends a last-minute update. If you can, bring your toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, got it—Saturday at 9 by the leaking shed roof, and I’ll bring my toolbox. I can be there to help, and I’ll keep an ear out in case Jules changes anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s shaping up well for Saturday—Gus has the main tools covered, and Cleo’s tracking gloves, tape, and spare screws. If you know what Ira still needs for the repair drive, I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—I'm still out running errands, so add screws and extension cords for now, and keep me posted if anything else changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it—I’m adding screws and extension cords to the list, and I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the confirmed repairs list, and somebody please double-check the exact Saturday time at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Fine, but before I count on it, can you confirm who’s actually bringing tools and how the heavy stuff is getting moved on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Friday after pickup is when folks are supposed to drop tools and spare parts, but I’d have Opal or Hana confirm exactly who’s bringing what; for the heavy stuff Saturday, Jules is checking who from the other groups can help move it.
